# Disable Bot HE Only - r5

Corrects r4's overly broad grenade disable. Only bot high-explosive (HE) grenades are blocked. Flashbangs, smoke grenades, molotovs/incendiaries and decoys use the original NadeSystem v1.2.3 behavior in normal mode.

- Restore the original grenade module event handlers, strategies, timings and commands.
- Exclude HE from the lineup database and reject HE at replay, central projectile creation and instant grenade entry points.
- Keep native bot grenade throwing disabled as in the original package; allowed grenade types continue to be generated by NadeSystem. Human players' grenades are unaffected.
- Restore bot_nades normal in all three mode configs and use normal as the plugin startup default.
- Keep Medium reaction tuning: Pro templates +100 ms, Rank templates +40 ms.
- All other plugin binaries, compatibility updates, skins, maps and aim behavior remain unchanged.

Close CS2 completely before overwriting the installation with release-windows.zip, then restart. The NadeSystem version should be 1.2.3-nohe.1. bot_nades should report normal. If an old console/config command sets bot_nades off, run bot_nades normal to restore the allowed grenade types; HE remains blocked even in more/max mode.

Build, managed API compatibility, HE/non-HE policy cases and package differences are checked. In-game play testing is still required.
